data.name: SHIFT: A Game Made to Be Broken
data.detailed_description:
SHIFT is a puzzle platformer built around one core idea: exploiting the rules.

Every level gives you the opportunity to solve it like a normal puzzle platformer OR find another way. Whether it's exploiting vertical momentum or strategically restarting the level, SHIFT is a game that was meant to be broken.

SHIFT contains 10 levels where the player controls platforms by pressing corresponding buttons. By shifting platforms around, you can create a way across the canyon! Players learn the rules of many types of platforms. Red platforms go back and forth 5 times. Blue platforms go from one side to the other. Yellow platforms go back and forth after a delay. And glitch pads are unpredictable but normally lead to being launched high into the air. You have to know the rules to break the rules. Now find your own path!

Features:

  • Puzzle platforming focused on player creativity and discovery

  • Mechanics designed to be bent, broken, and reimagined

  • Hidden solutions and emergent gameplay in every level

  • A subtle, mysterious narrative told by uncovering secrets

  • Short, focused experience with high replayability

data.short_description: A puzzle platformer that starts by teaching you the rules—then dares you to break them. Bend mechanics, exploit systems, and discover solutions the game never intended.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
